From paragliders crashing into the mountainside, to scramblers who have fallen down waterfalls or adventurers becoming lost in the tunnel systems of disused quarries, the volunteers will drop everything to head out to the hills and bring home the lost, injured and stricken. In this episode, the team is dispatched to help a man with a dislocated shoulder at the popular Eskdale Pools. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

To recognise his bravery, Alan and the team surprise the whole Rendall family and turn their featureless plot into an automobile-inspired haven

Land agent Rupert Acton and his family join the trio for a picnic, before using historic maps to follow an authentic Edwardian hiking trail

From paragliders crashing into the mountainside, to scramblers who have fallen down waterfalls or adventurers becoming lost in the tunnel systems of disused quarries, the volunteers will drop everything to head out to the hills and bring home the lost, injured and stricken. In this episode, the team is dispatched to help a man with a dislocated shoulder at the popular Eskdale Pools. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

In July 2014, he managed to rescue his unconscious neighbour, Roy Whiteway, from his burning house, but was unable to save Dorothy, Roy's wife, as the fire was so intense. To recognise his bravery, Alan and the team surprise the whole Rendall family and turn their featureless plot into an automobile-inspired haven

Land agent Rupert Acton and his family join the trio for a picnic, before using historic maps to follow an authentic Edwardian hiking trail
